notes.title: KarmaCrown's v.1.0.4 patch
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay changes[/b]
- SoundTracks are added to the game.
(Character select screen, each stage.)

notes.title: KarmaCrown's v1.0.3 patch
notes.content:
[b]User convenience patch[/b]
Added Restart and Quit button when the player is dead.
(Restart button leads to character select screen.)

notes.title: KarmaCrown's v1.0.2 patch
notes.content:
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
- Fixed issue that sound in the main menu is not looped.

[b]Balance changes[/b]
- Character's movement is improved. 
  (feels less walking on the icy ground)
- Stations price is reduced from 4 to 3. except weapon chest.
- Props are less spawned in the Stage.

[b]Other changes[/b]
- Added V-sync toggle in the setting menu.
- Added advanced game play menu.
- Added screen shake/frame freeze toggle in the game play menu.
  (both scale sliders are moved in the advanced game play menu.)
- Added Item window show/hide toggle in the advanced game play menu.
- Players can now go to the main menu when in the character select room.
- Credit remains much longer.

notes.title: KarmaCrown's v1.0.1 patch is here
notes.content:
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
- Fixed issue Some of the gun's sound is not playing.
- Fixed Item 'FocusRens' is not applied on laser weapons
- Fixed issue that texts were overlapping.
- Fixed issue that item is disappeared when the player buys item too close to the wall

[b]Balance fixes[/b]
- GranadeLancher's weight has been reduced (0.5 -> 0.8)
- Station's price has been reduced (5 -> 4)
